caption:
Chicken Chapli Kebab
high protein | meal prep friendly | 30 minute recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 12 | F: 9 | P: 36
Calories: 285 per serve
makes around 9 kebabs (serving size 3 kebabs) 

Ingredients
450 grams Chicken mince (+ 1 egg optional)
1 onion, finely chopped
2 tomatoes, chopped
large handful of chopped coriander
1 tsp garam masala powder
1 tsp jeera powder
½ tsp haldi
½ tsp red chilli powder
½ tsp black pepper
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
2 green chillies, chopped
salt to taste
1 tsp olive oil for cooking in the pan 

Method
combine all the ingredients in a bowl sans the olive oil and set aside in the fridge till ready to use
add a pan to the stove add in oil and allow to heat
scoop in 3-4 patties depending on the size of your pan ( i use around 1 large heaping tbsp of mix per patty )
smash it down gently as i prefer a thinner kebab in this case
cook on both sides and serve with my favorite coriander dip :)
